title: Human-like session: implement Go item store across three turns
description: Three scripted human turns build a Go item store incrementally: turn 1 implements GetItem, turn 2 implements ParseID, turn 3 implements DeleteItem and runs the tests. Full test suite provided upfront; progression is guided by human prompts, not failure output.

task_spec.prompt: Implement `GetItem(id int)` in items.go. Look up the id in the `store` map and return `(item, nil)` if found, or `(nil, ErrNotFound)` if the id is not in the map. Do not implement ParseID or DeleteItem yet.
followup_prompts: Good. Now implement `ParseID(s string)`. Use `strconv.Atoi` to parse s. Return an error if the parse fails, or if the resulting integer is not positive (i.e. <= 0). Return the integer and nil on success.

Now implement `DeleteItem(id int)`. Check if the id exists in the store map; if not, return ErrNotFound. If it does, delete it with `delete(store, id)` and return nil. Then run `go test ./...` to verify all 8 tests pass and fix any remaining failures.
success_criteria: GetItem returns ErrNotFound for missing ids
ParseID rejects non-positive and non-numeric inputs
DeleteItem removes from store and returns ErrNotFound for missing ids
